speaker: client
text: Let’s hold off on moving forward until we finesse the character style a bit. It keeps drifting, and I’ve struggled to keep it precise. Red Fern and Blue Lantern are close to the target; Kestrel is furthest away because he feels too clean, too simple, and too polished. What I want instead is more of a raw graffiti aesthetic. Could you do a quick pass applying that style to all three of them and send me the results?
